2. **Formula:**
   The mass of one atom of a substance is given by:
   \[
   \text{mass of one atom} = \frac{\text{molar mass}}{\text{Avogadro's constant}}
   \]

   \text{mass of one gold atom} = \frac{197 \, \text{g/mol}}{6.02 \times 10^{23} \, \text{mol}^{-1}}
